answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, expired if not renewed by fresh work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. By the basalt of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The mesa lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the dawn is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
